name: Charles-Henri Sanson
source:
An executioner during the French Revolution, he killed countless numbers of people before being brought back to life in the 19th Century by Vlad. Now working as a doctor, is bright smile and warm, friendly personality draws everybody in.
But be careful- once he makes his way into your heart, he becomes utterly addicted to you...

"You can do whatever you want with me, just love me more and more..."
